_comment: Exact schema for every mobile card type. All fields sent to the AI must match these shapes. 'card_type' is the discriminator — must use these exact string values.

text.title: Card title (required, non-empty)
text.content: Plain string — the body text shown on the card (required, non-empty)

text_img.title: Card title (required)
text_img.content: Plain string — supporting text shown below the image
text_img.illustration_idea: Detailed description of what to draw (required for image generation)
text_img.visible_labels: Comma-separated labels to render on the diagram (optional)

img_only.title: Card title (required)
img_only.img_context: Extra context for image generation (not rendered as text)
img_only.illustration_idea: Detailed description of what to draw (required for image generation)
img_only.visible_labels: Comma-separated labels to render on the diagram (optional)

highlightCard.title: Card title (required, non-empty)
highlightCard.content: Plain string — the highlighted text body (required, non-empty)

comparisonCards.title: Card title (required)
comparisonCards.heading: Optional sub-heading displayed above both sides

quiz.title: Card title (required)
quiz.question: The quiz question text (required)
quiz._comment_correct_answer: 1-based integer index matching an option id

recapCard.title: Card title (required)
recapCard.heading: Optional overall heading for the recap

fillInTheBlank.title: Card title (required)
fillInTheBlank.question: Sentence with ___ for the blank (required)
fillInTheBlank._comment_correct_options: Array of the correct answer strings — must match exactly one entry in options

text-with-code.title: Card title (required)
text-with-code.text_1: Text shown above the code block (required)
text-with-code.text_2: Text shown below the code block (optional)
text-with-code.language: Programming language identifier e.g. python, javascript, java

code-with-output.title: Card title (required)
code-with-output.output: Expected output text (required when output_available is 'true')

type_aliases._comment: The normalizer accepts these aliases in addition to the canonical names above

image_cards_note: text_img and img_only cards require a valid imageUrl on the stored card record (populated by the image generation stage). If imageUrl is missing, img_only is skipped entirely; text_img falls back to a plain text card.
empty_card_guard: content for text / highlightCard MUST be a plain string, not a nested object. If the AI wraps it as {text: '...'}, the normalizer extracts .text automatically.
